preview.title: This is how it looks
preview.text: An example with made-up booking details. Your client sees their own date, time and treatment.

therapist.settingsText: The e-mail your clients get after booking
therapist.lead: Your clients receive this e-mail straight after they book and pay.
therapist.welcome1: We fill in the date, time, address, price and your cancellation rules for you.
therapist.welcome2: You only write a short, personal message. We've written one to start with. Change it as you like, or leave it as it is.
therapist.welcome3: Clients can reply to the e-mail. Their reply goes to your public e-mail address (see Profile).
therapist.messageText: This message is used for all your treatments.
therapist.hint: Write as you would speak to a client. Short sentences are easiest to read.
therapist.savedText: New bookings get this message from now on.
therapist.perServiceTitle: A different message for one treatment
therapist.perServiceText: Optional. For example, what to wear or bring for a massage.
therapist.removed: This treatment now uses your general message
therapist.noServices: You have no treatments yet. Add them under “Services and prices” first.

admin.title: E-mails
admin.lead: The e-mails the platform sends to clients, and the centre information in them.
admin.welcome1: After every booking, the client gets a confirmation e-mail with the date, time, address and price.
admin.welcome2: Each therapist writes their own short message in it. You write the centre information below, which goes into every e-mail.
admin.welcome3: Use “Send an example” to see exactly what a client receives.
admin.statusOutbox: Not connected yet. E-mails are not sent; you can see them in the list below.
admin.statusDemo: Connected to {provider}. Because this is the demo, real e-mails only go to: {list}. All others appear in the list below.
admin.statusDemoNone: Connected to {provider}. Because this is the demo, no real e-mails are sent yet: add your own address to EMAIL_DEMO_RECIPIENTS to receive them.
admin.statusLive: Connected to {provider}. E-mails are sent from {from}.
admin.infoText: Address, parking, what to do on arrival. This goes into every confirmation.
admin.exampleText: We send a confirmation with made-up booking details, so you can see how it arrives.
admin.exampleSentText: Have a look in your inbox in a minute. Check your spam folder too.
admin.exampleOutboxText: It was not really sent. You can see it in the list below.
admin.exampleFailed: The example could not be sent. Check the e-mail address and the connection, then try again.
admin.outboxText: The newest first. This list starts again after each update of the platform.
admin.outboxEmpty: No e-mails yet. Book an appointment on the website or send an example.
admin.noContent: The content of real e-mails is not kept, to protect clients' privacy.
